text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Thank you for your consideration of this matter.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate for appointment to the Community Centre 55 Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2025 and until a successor is appointed: Laura Beaune.
